name: memory_recall
description: Get everything known about one entity: type, summary, attributes, recent facts, and incoming/outgoing relations.

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. invariant, decision, architecture).

session_id.description: Only include facts with this session label.

limit.description: Maximum facts (newest first), where has_more_observations signals truncation. If true, re-call with limit=100 or use memory_search.

relation_limit.description: Maximum relations per direction, where has_more_outgoing_relations and has_more_incoming_relations signal truncation. If true, re-call with relation_limit=100.
